nodes.description: Owner address state variable of Ownable, set in constructor and updated by transferOwnership.
Ownable constructor that assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
Ownable function guarded by onlyOwner that lets the current owner reassign ownership to newOwner.
Indorser function that loops over recipient and value arrays and performs token transfers.
msg.sender used as the initial owner in the Ownable constructor.
msg.sender compared against owner in the onlyOwner modifier to enforce access control.
External call Token(_tokenAddr).transfer(...) executed inside the multisend loop with attacker-supplied token address, enabling reentrancy.
Arithmetic loop counter increment i++ on a uint8 whose bound is compared against _to.length, at risk of overflow.
Address parameter newOwner of transferOwnership, the new ownership target.
Address parameter _tokenAddr of multisend, the token contract to call.
Address array parameter _to of multisend, the recipient list.
uint256 array parameter _value of multisend, the amounts to transfer.
uint8 local loop counter i used to index _to and _value in multisend.
Token interface function transfer(address to, uint value) invoked externally by multisend.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read in the Ownable constructor and assigned as the owner.
The constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable.
The onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender against owner and gates execution of transferOwnership.
newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership and, if non-zero, into the owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the newOwner value into the owner state variable.
multisend drives execution of the external Token.transfer call inside its loop.
Attacker-controlled _tokenAddr is used to construct the Token interface for the external call.
Attacker-controlled _to array supplies recipients to the external Token.transfer call.
Attacker-controlled _value array supplies amounts to the external Token.transfer call.
The external call invokes Token.transfer, an untrusted callback that can reenter multisend.
Loop counter i indexes the arrays used in the external call arguments.
The uint8 loop counter i is incremented in the loop arithmetic, risking overflow.
_to.length is the loop bound compared against the uint8 counter in the loop arithmetic.
The loop counter arithmetic controls iteration and therefore each external call execution.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is a parameter consumed only by transferOwnership to update the owner state variable.
_tokenAddr is a parameter used only to build the Token target of the external call.
_to is a parameter consumed only as recipient list of the external transfer call.
_value is a parameter consumed only as amount list of the external transfer call.
i is a temporary counter that exists solely for the loop arithmetic and array indexing.
